name: A Fine and Private Place "Kokochiyoku Himitsumeita Basho"
original_name: A Fine and Private Place「心地よく秘密めいた場所」
source: The protagonist, lost in the mountains, meets a girl dressed in a kimono who leads him to a hidden village that seems to have been left behind by time. A tragedy. An unending nightmare. Will the protagonist escape?
translation: The protagonist, lost in the mountains, meets a girl dressed in a kimono who leads him to a hidden village that seems to have been left behind by time. A tragedy. An unending nightmare. Will the protagonist escape?
